title: API: a status change with no parts is refused with Select at least one part.
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin. (Admin has Part Library & Inventory > Delete.) API calls are replayed from Chrome DevTools against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com: Network tab, right-click a captured request > Copy as fetch, edit method/URL/body in the Console; header X-Location-ID = the current location's id. Note the counts on the Inventory Active and Inactive tabs and the newest entry in QAPL-T1's Part History (no DB access: results are checked through the API and the UI).
custom_steps:
1. PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status {"partIds":[],"status":"inactive","note":"Superseded by RC-500X"}.
  2. PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status {"status":"inactive"} (partIds missing).
  3. PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status {"partIds":[],"status":"active"}.
  4. Reload Parts > Inventory and check the Active and Inactive tabs.
  5. GET /api/parts/history/<QAPL-T1 id>.
custom_expected:
1. 400 "Select at least one part."; nothing is written.
  2. 400 "Select at least one part."
  3. 400 "Select at least one part."
  4. Both tabs show the same counts as before.
  5. 200; the newest entry is the one noted before: no Deactivated or Activated entry was written.
